title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Member Terms: Late Charge Waiver for Long-Standing Accounts
content:
## Member loyalty terms: tenure waiver of installment late charges

**Term.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, part of the late charge is waived for a long-standing account with no failed plan: half of the late charge when the account has been open 60 whole months or more and no payment-plan request on it recorded as cancelled was made in the 48 whole months before the handling date, a quarter of the late charge when it has been open 24 through 59 whole months with no such cancelled request, and nothing in every other case.

The waived part is a share of the original late charge. Waived shares are added together and taken off the original late charge once.

### Waiver table

| Whole months open | Payment-plan request recorded as cancelled in the 48 whole months before the handling date | Share of the late charge waived |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | none | half (0.5) |
| 24 through 59 | none | a quarter (0.25) |
| 24 or more | one or more | nothing |
| fewer than 24 | any | nothing |

### Hypothetical cases (late charge of 10.00)

- 72 whole months open, no cancelled plan request in the 48-month span: 5.00 waived.
- 30 whole months open, no cancelled request: 2.50 waived.
- 72 whole months open, a plan request cancelled 20 months ago: nothing waived.
- 23 whole months open: nothing waived.
